missed.part: ADS7046IRUGR (C543003), 12 bit, 3 MSPS, X2QFN-8 1.5 x 1.5 mm
missed.why: Passes every requirement value read. SBAS785 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads7046.pdf, read 2026-10-02T00:31:07Z): input sampled with the CS falling edge (Description, 8.4.1); aperture jitter 12 ps RMS, aperture delay 3 ns (6.5), so converter variation is far inside 52 ns; AVDD 2.35 to 3.6 V and 'also provides the reference voltage' (Pin Functions), input 0 V to AVDD with AINM to GND; SDO tri-state while CS is high, tdz_CSDO 5.5 ns max (6.7); frame of 15 SCLK falling edges (leading 0, 12 data bits, 2 zeros; 8.4.2), inside the 4 to 16 bit frame; the data of each frame belong to the sample taken at the previous CS edge, one frame of constant latency; SINAD 69 dB min (11.17 bits) and 71.1 dB typ at 2 kHz, AVDD 3.3 V; -40 to 125 degC; DVDD 1.65 to 3.6 V independent of AVDD, 3 MSPS; sampling capacitance 16 pF; no input leakage figure stated. JLCPCB stockCount 771, presale 762, expand, 4.2836 at 10 (2026-10-02T00:35:58Z, vendors.py jlcpcb C543003). Digi-Key API (productdetails ADS7046IRUGR, 2026-10-02T00:37:47Z): Active, lead time 20 weeks, stock 267 (cut tape), so rule 5 by the same part at Digi-Key. TI product page marketingStatusDescription ACTIVE (https://www.ti.com/product/ADS7046, 2026-10-02T00:38:14Z). Not considered by P2, which read only TI's ADS7886 and ADS7866 of this vendor's SAR families. Siblings checked and not finds: ADS7052 and ADS7056 (14 bit) need 18 SCLK per frame (tCONV = 18 x tSCLK), over the 16 bit frame; ADS7042, ADS7043, ADS7044 and ADS7049-Q1 state no aperture jitter; ADS7047, ADS7054, ADS7057 take a differential input (+/-AVDD range), which does not give the 0 V to VS span on one single-ended output.

Passes every requirement value read, with REF tied to the 3.3 V rail. SBAS572B (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads8864.pdf, read 2026-10-02T00:31:10Z): in 3-wire CS mode a CONVST rising edge forces DOUT to 3-state, samples the input and starts the conversion (9.4.1.1), so CONVST is the chip select and the sample instant is a chip-select edge the PIO drives; aperture jitter 5 ps RMS, aperture delay 4 ns (7.5); 16 SCLK frame, conversion result read in the next CS-low window, DOUT 3-state when CONVST is high (td-CNV-DOhz 13.2 ns), SCLK 16 to 66.6 MHz; AVDD 2.7 to 3.6 V; REF input range 2.5 to 5 V with a 10 to 22 uF decoupling capacitor, so REF on the same 3.3 V rail (3.201 to 3.399 V) gives a full scale that follows the ADXL316 supply; input span 0 to VREF, AINN to GND; input leakage 5 nA typ; -40 to 85 degC. Limit: the SINAD minimum of 90.5 dB is stated at VREF = 5 V only, not at 3.3 V (typical curves only), and the REF pin draws 100 uA pulses from the rail. 16 bits give a 50 uV step at 3.3 V against the 86 uV of 0.1 degree. JLCPCB stockCount 1971, presale 1963, expand, 7.2049 at 10 (2026-10-02T00:35:59Z). Digi-Key (2026-10-02T00:37:49Z): Active, lead 20 weeks, stock 2877. TI page ACTIVE (https://www.ti.com/product/ADS8864, 2026-10-02T00:38:14Z). Not considered by P2.

P2 returned no function entry for it: LM4040AIM3-3.0/NOPB, REF3330AIDBZR, REF35300QDBVR and the other references appear only in its dropped list, with the reason that Q4 chose the external ADC (owner, 2026-09-29). selection.json still carries LM4040AIM3-3.0/NOPB as a verified q_alternative with option 'reference', so the record and P2's return disagree.
